translated_title: Collectives and Cubans in Mexico City March, 73 Years After the Assault on the Moncada Barracks, Against US Attacks on the Island
original_title: Colectivos y cubanos en CDMX marchan, a 73 años del asalto al Cuartel Moncada, contra agresiones de EU a la isla
author: Jared Laureles and Iván Evair Saldaña
meta_description: Backed by a hundred organizations, the march to the former US embassy answers Trump's invasion threats and the six-decade blockade against Cuba.
